visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up shot of several plush characters arranged inside a wooden dim sum steamer on a white marble surface. A woman with light brown hair, wearing a white sleeveless top and a beige skirt, stands in front of a bright neon sign featuring cartoon characters and the text 'chiikawa yumcha'. (2) A wide shot shows the entrance of the 'Chiikawa Days' exhibition inside a shopping mall, featuring green forest-themed graphics. The woman is seen entering and exploring the interior, which is filled with neon signs, colorful character cutouts, and various themed display booths with bright studio lighting. (3) The woman interacts with a series of life-sized character statues: she sits on the floor next to characters at a tree stump table, poses with a giant white monster figure, and stands inside a cell-like display with characters in striped uniforms. Each setting is intricately detailed with props like plastic food and thematic backgrounds. (4) Close-up shots feature merchandise including a pink and blue light-up wand and a box set containing character cards. The woman demonstrates the wand's light-up feature. (5) Outdoor night scenes show large inflatable character figures positioned at a harbor front with city skyline lights in the background. The woman poses in front of these giant installations and other oversized food-shaped props under artificial night lighting. (6) The video showcases themed retail displays with bags, umbrellas, t-shirts, and a mahjong set featuring the cartoon characters. (7) Footage of public transport reveals themed subway turnstiles with character graphics and a blue double-decker bus fully wrapped in character advertisements moving through a busy urban street. (8) The video concludes with the woman in a black t-shirt making peace signs in front of a final character display, smiling at the camera.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a comprehensive travel vlog and promotional guide for the 'Chiikawa Days' exhibition in Hong Kong. It aims to showcase the scale and variety of the event, including indoor displays, outdoor installations at Victoria Harbour, exclusive local merchandise, and themed public transportation to attract fans and tourists.
